import os, re, shutil, subprocess, sys, tempfile, zipfile
from pathlib import Path

inputs = [
    ("animal", "/jetstream2/scratch/main/jobs/78549320/inputs/dataset_8b4b72ea-0eeb-4bac-8c9d-fe8981e98bc5.dat"),
    ("fungal", "/jetstream2/scratch/main/jobs/78549320/inputs/dataset_178f523f-6705-4cca-b5c3-a22f134c02e6.dat"),
]
float_re = re.compile(r'[-+]?(?:\d+(?:\.\d*)?|\.\d+)(?:[eE][-+]?\d+)?')

def safe_member_name(name):
    p = Path(name)
    if p.is_absolute() or '..' in p.parts:
        raise ValueError(f"unsafe zip member: {name}")
    return p.name

def parse_rcv(stdout):
    nums = float_re.findall(stdout)
    if not nums:
        raise ValueError(f"no numeric RCV found in PhyKIT output: {stdout!r}")
    return float(nums[-1])

with open('rcv_scores.tsv', 'w') as out:
    out.write('group\trcv\tortholog\n')
    total = {}
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
        work = Path(td)
        for group, archive_path in inputs:
            extracted = work / group
            extracted.mkdir()
            with zipfile.ZipFile(archive_path) as zf:
                members = sorted(n for n in zf.namelist() if n.endswith('.faa.mafft') and not n.endswith('/'))
                if not members:
                    raise RuntimeError(f"no .faa.mafft alignments found for {group}")
                total[group] = len(members)
                for idx, name in enumerate(members, 1):
                    ortholog = safe_member_name(name).replace('.faa.mafft', '')
                    aln = extracted / f"{idx:06d}_{safe_member_name(name)}"
                    with zf.open(name) as src, open(aln, 'wb') as dst:
                        shutil.copyfileobj(src, dst)
                    proc = subprocess.run(
                        ['phykit', 'relative_composition_variability', str(aln)],
                        text=True, capture_output=True, check=False,
                    )
                    if proc.returncode != 0:
                        raise RuntimeError(f"PhyKIT failed for {group} {name}: {proc.stderr}\n{proc.stdout}")
                    rcv = parse_rcv(proc.stdout)
                    out.write(f"{group}\t{rcv:.17g}\t{ortholog}\n")
    with open('summary.txt', 'w') as s:
        for group in sorted(total):
            s.write(f"{group}\t{total[group]}\n")
PY
